title: A trader-confirmed decision executes in the trader's own paper book through existing owners
problem_register_class: RC4 - Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader
flow: Trader presses 確認執行 / 修改部位: the decision lock and a TradingIntent (metadata.decision approve|modify, metadata.human_decision_id) are written as before.

POST /bff/agora/trading-intents/{id}/handoffs with requested_stage=paper, handoff_type=paper_execution_request: the BFF validates the request (confirmed decision, action enter/add/reduce/exit, positive share quantity, optional limit, symbol equals the intent subject, no short), stamps target_queue=paper_execution and a paper_execution block (environment paper, owner tenant/user/servant persona, order, decision lock id, daily_cap 50), and records it request-only.

paper-signal-producer cycle: AgoraPaperIntentConsumer drains open handoffs (GET /internal/agora/paper-execution/handoffs, service token + actor + tenant allow-list), validates stage, owner, the trader's own active paper RuntimeBinding (metadata persona equals the servant persona, tenant equals, paper), the order, and a stored Source price (fresh within 4 days), claims one of 50 daily slots, writes accepted back (compare-and-set on submitted), then enqueues one paper signal through DecisionSignalProducer on the binding queue (signal id uuid5 of the handoff id, environment paper, is_real_order false).

The paper runtime (existing order-level risk gate) and the broker paper simulator execute the signal; the consumer reads the broker paper order by client_order_id and writes filled / partially_filled (or rejected broker_rejected) back to the handoff and the intent state.

security_condition.operator_approval: 2026-11-27 (coordinator 70b5f70f): artifact adds approved on the condition that the paper-execution service token never works with its public default
security_condition.risk: the repository is public and /internal/agora/* is reachable through the public api.dev host (401 without a token), so the compose default token is public knowledge
security_condition.rule: outside the explicit local profile (AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_TOKEN_PROFILE=local, never in staging/prod posture) an unset, empty, public-default, env-example or placeholder (replace-me/changeme/change-me/example/dummy/placeholder prefix) token leaves the lane not_configured
security_condition.operator_bff: every call to /internal/agora/paper-execution/* answers 503 with detail {boundary, state: not_configured, reason, token_profile}; the same state is logged once at router build (never the token); the service starts and stays healthy
security_condition.paper_signal_producer: consumer_status_from_env returns no consumer and health file field agora_paper_intent_consumer = {state: not_configured, reason}; never raises (PANTHEON_AGORA_PAPER_INTENT_CONSUMER=on with a missing secret no longer raises); the producer keeps its strategy cycle and is not degraded
security_condition.wiring: docker-compose.yml passes AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_SERVICE_TOKEN and AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_TOKEN_PROFILE (default local) to operator-bff and paper-signal-producer; GitHub secret DEV_AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_SERVICE_TOKEN -> nonprod-deploy.yml env (all 8 DEV_OPENCLAW_ADAPTER_SERVICE_TOKEN sites) -> deploy_nonprod_vm.sh maps to AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_SERVICE_TOKEN, passes it through the remote command prefix with shell_quote, logs dev_agora_paper_execution_service_token_configured=true|false, and runs compose with AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_TOKEN_PROFILE=hosted. No deploy refusal was added (2026-11-17 rule); a missing secret cannot roll back a dev deploy
